policy: Every threshold below is fixed before a single override is measured. They are derived from the evidence distributions already published in 01-shadow-diagnostics.json and 02-shadow-root.json, never from how well an override turns out. Tuning them against override accuracy would make F2R a measurement of the tuning rather than of the approach, which is what F2 was run to avoid.
supersedes: nothing. Stage F2's finding stands: the factorized root is worse than phase4-v1 overall, and F2b is not adopted.

default.note: The product's root is the default and stays the default. F2R only ever proposes replacing it, and abstains unless every condition below is met.

scope.walkingNote: Walking bass is excluded entirely and belongs to Stage F2W. Stage F2 measured its shadow top1 at 11.8% and top3 at 60.9%: the candidate set itself is unreliable there, so a correction rule built on it would be guessing.
scope.plainTriadDefinition: The window sounds the root, a third and a fifth of the product's Top 1, no seventh, and the lowest note is the root. Derived from the notes, never from a corpus subset label or a fixture id.
scope.plainTriadRationale: Stage F2 measured plain triads at 100% for both the product and the shadow. There is nothing to correct and everything to lose.

conditions.requirement: shadowScore(productTop1) and shadowScore(alternative) differ by no more than contestBand
conditions.derivation: Published rootMargin mean is 0.14444. A third of that is the point below which the two candidates are not meaningfully separated by the evidence. Chosen from the margin distribution, not from outcomes.

conditions.requirement: relationMargin >= relationMarginFloor AND bassEvidenceAmount >= bassEvidenceFloor AND bassMargin >= bassMarginFloor
conditions.derivation: Relation scores span 0..1, so a quarter of the scale is a clear lead. Published bassEvidenceAmount mean is 1.030237 and bassMargin mean is 0.878402; the floors sit at roughly half of each, so a window with unusually thin or unusually divided bass evidence is not eligible.
Positive structural evidence, not merely a higher score. A candidate with no skeleton above it is an artefact of the weighting.

conditions.requirement: rootPresence[productTop1] == 0 OR the defining triad tone of the product's Top 1 is 'contradicted'
conditions.derivation: A correction needs a reason to disbelieve the incumbent, not just a reason to like the challenger. 'Underdetermined' is deliberately not enough: Stage F1 exists because absence is not denial.

conditions.requirement: alternative is in the shadow root Top 3, or is the product's own bass or an existing product alternative
conditions.derivation: Stage F2 measured shadow Top 3 at 100% on inversion and pedal/slash. Restricting to that set keeps corrections inside the candidate pool that was shown to contain the answer.

conditions.requirement: If any condition above fails, abstain. Abstaining is the default outcome, not a fallback.
conditions.derivation: Stage F2's overall shadow accuracy is below the product's. A rule that fires often would import that deficit; a rule that fires rarely and precisely is the only shape worth having.

promotionStance.note: F2R reports a recommendation and nothing else. Even a clean result does not connect anything; that decision is the user's.
